test_ir_baseline_integration: test the ir_baseline model on integration_tests task and assert f1 score is at least 0.99
test_ir_baseline_babi: test the ir_baseline model on babi task1k:1 and assert expected f1 scores
test_ir_baseline_fixed_label: test the ir_baseline model with a manually written fixed label candidates file
test_ir_baseline_fixed_label2: test the ir_baseline model with candidates built via BuildCandidates.main and assert f1 equals 1.0
run_test_ir_baseline_suite: run the full TestIrBaseline unittest suite to validate ir_baseline model training and evaluation
